title: Last Player Alive
description: Last Player Alive is a Minecraft event plugin that tracks alive and dead players, gives admins full control, and automatically detects when only one player remains alive.
body:
# 🏆 Last Player Alive

**Last Player Alive** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin designed for survival-style games, events, and competitions.
The plugin tracks player states (Alive / Dead / Admin), manages the game flow, and automatically helps staff control and monitor the match until **only one player remains alive.**

Perfect for events, mini-games, SMP challenges, and organized survival competitions.

## ✨ Features

🔍 **Live Player Tracking** – Tracks whether players are alive, dead, or in admin mode

⚔️ **Game Control System** – Start, stop, and manage the game easily

❤️ **Revive & Kill Players** – Full control over player states

🧭 **Teleport Tools** – Instantly teleport alive or dead players to you

🚨 **Last Player Detection** – Automatically identifies when only one player remains alive

🛠️ **Admin Mode** – Special mode for staff to manage the game without affecting gameplay

♻️ **Config Reloading** – Reload the config without restarting the server

## 🎨 Custom Messages & HEX Colors

Last Player Alive uses custom HEX color codes for all messages.

**How it works:**

Use # followed by the HEX color number

To make text bold, use:

#HEXCODE&lYour text


Normal Minecraft colors also work by using a single color number after #

All messages can be edited from the config.yml file.

## ⌨️ Commands

⚠️ The plugin will not work unless toggled ON.

**Main command shortcuts:**
/lastp or /lastplayer
(For simplicity, NOT /lastplayeralive)

Available Commands:

/lastp toggle – **Required** to enable the plugin

/lastp start / /lastp stop – Start or stop the game

/lastp revive <player> – Revive a dead player

/lastp kill <player> – Kill a player

/lastp tp – Teleport alive or dead players to you

/lastp reload – Reload the config.yml

/lastp status <player> – Check player status (Alive / Dead / Admin)

/v admin <player> – Set a player into admin mode

## 🐞 Bug Reports

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please report them to:

**Discord:** _adomi - 
**Support languages:** Hebrew, English

## ❤️ Final Notes

**Last Player Alive** is built to be simple, powerful, and event-friendly.
Whether you're running a hardcore challenge or a large community event — this plugin gives you full control **until the last player survives.**

**Have fun!**
